author: Bibek Parajuli
review_text: Esewa is one of best payment wallet of Nepal having multiple features from basic to another level. I liked the UI of the application and the transactions are also smooth and have no problem with that. I suggest one feature that would be very helpful if added in application. Please add option for Changing the phone number, since there is option to add a secondary device but not to change the esewa I'd, I contacted the support but they're on their own problem on that thing.
